debugData.name: Showcase coast
debugData.description: terrainShowcase's coast block (p310 §3.3): the terrain add-on's export (devTools/blender/buildShowcaseBlocks.py), 64 m / 129, dunes falling toward the sea (the engine's +z) under the scene's 0.5 m water level and a 7-9 m cliff band along the north edge, its COLOR_0 painted (sand02 along the waterline, rocks01 at the cliff foot and in three islands, cliffs01 on the face) with the AO baked into its A; pebbles on the gravel and rocks at the cliff foot scattered by terrainScatter, and two tyre tracks across the beach (its decal set).
